knobs.name: hookW1
knobs.what: s: the headline word TOO MUCH appears

knobs.name: hookW2
knobs.what: s: the headline word ALMOST NONE replaces it over the same still mark

knobs.name: hookWOut
knobs.what: s: the headline words leave

knobs.name: hookPush0
knobs.what: s: the slow push toward the mark starts (camera still before this, R-E template)

knobs.name: hookPush1
knobs.what: s: the push ends (HOOK ends at 12)

knobs.name: hookZoom
knobs.what: x: size of the first mark after the push (the ruler and the first rung keep it)

knobs.name: panelIn
knobs.what: s: the crowd panel (the base) appears around the mark

knobs.name: rulerAt
knobs.what: s: the ruler tick equal to one mark appears

knobs.name: whAt
knobs.what: s: the first count lands: 0.24 Wh

knobs.name: mwAt
knobs.what: s: the microwave anchor and its seconds

knobs.name: bulbAt
knobs.what: s: the bulb anchor and its seconds

knobs.name: ladderT0
knobs.what: s: the first move of the ladder (1 -> 10 queries) starts

knobs.name: dwell
knobs.what: s: hold on each rung (>= 2.5 for a new number)

knobs.name: move
knobs.what: s: the move between rungs

knobs.name: swap0
knobs.what: s: the 10^5 field starts to shrink into ONE tile (second tier)

knobs.name: swap1
knobs.what: s: 100,000 tiles are on screen

knobs.name: gwhAt
knobs.what: s: the site day: 2.4 GWh

knobs.name: tilesAt
knobs.what: s: 100,000 tiles lands

knobs.name: billionAt
knobs.what: s: the same energy as queries: 10 billion

knobs.name: cutB
knobs.what: s: hard cut from the tile field to the world field (3D)

knobs.name: bIn0
knobs.what: s: the inked cubes start to count in (spiral order, centre out)

knobs.name: bIn1
knobs.what: s: the last inked cube is in (the count lands at worldAt)

knobs.name: worldAt
knobs.what: s: 415 TWh lands

knobs.name: pctAt
knobs.what: s: 1.5 % lands (>= 5 s after the count)

knobs.name: moveT0
knobs.what: s: the inked cubes start to travel into the region stacks (the rig orbit has the same t0)

knobs.name: moveT1
knobs.what: s: they have landed (the rig orbit has the same t1)

knobs.name: usAt
knobs.what: s: the US count lands

knobs.name: cnAt
knobs.what: s: the China count lands

knobs.name: euAt
knobs.what: s: the Europe count lands

knobs.name: shareAt
knobs.what: s: the three shares land

knobs.name: stagger
knobs.what: fraction of the move spent staggering layers (0 = all at once)

knobs.name: lift
knobs.what: world units: the hop a cube makes in flight

knobs.name: terrT
knobs.what: s: hard cut to the plan view of the terrain

knobs.name: revealT0
knobs.what: s: the matrix rows start to count in

knobs.name: revealT1
knobs.what: s: all 25 rows are in

knobs.name: ieCutT0
knobs.what: s: the cut band appears and travels to the Irish column (the rig tilt has the same t0)

knobs.name: ieCutT1
knobs.what: s: the cut sits on the Irish column

knobs.name: ieAt
knobs.what: s: 7,663 GWh lands

knobs.name: ie23At
knobs.what: s: 23 % lands (>= 5 s after the count)

knobs.name: ie15At
knobs.what: s: 15 times lands

knobs.name: usCutT0
knobs.what: s: the cut hops from Ireland to the US column (the rig swing has the same t0)

knobs.name: usCutT1
knobs.what: s: the cut sits on the US column

knobs.name: usTwhAt
knobs.what: s: 176 TWh lands

knobs.name: us44At
knobs.what: s: 4.4 % lands

knobs.name: usHalfAt
knobs.what: s: about half of the growth lands

knobs.name: pinsOn1
knobs.what: s: place pins come back after the tilt has settled

knobs.name: mondayAt
knobs.what: s: the terrain is dimmed and the question starts

knobs.name: honestAt
knobs.what: s: the honest-limits line appears on stage

knobs.name: dimA
knobs.what: opacity of the dimming veil over the terrain in MONDAY (0.6 = 40 % left)

knobs.name: resSize
knobs.what: units: the result number (must-read floor 28)

knobs.name: tagSize
knobs.what: units: the denominator word at the top left (must-read floor 28)

knobs.name: noteSize
knobs.what: units: the honest line on stage (secondary floor 14)

knobs.name: qSize
knobs.what: units: the MONDAY question words

knobs.name: panel
knobs.what: units: side of the crowd panel (the module uses 408)

knobs.name: panelY
knobs.what: units: top of the crowd panel

knobs.name: litMin
knobs.what: px: the lit first mark never gets smaller than this radius

knobs.name: frameA
knobs.what: opacity of the nested dashed frames (what each earlier view was)

knobs.name: cell
knobs.what: world units: pitch of one mark in the world field

knobs.name: tile
knobs.what: world units: side of one mark (a gap of pitch - side keeps marks countable)

knobs.name: layer
knobs.what: world units: vertical pitch of a stack layer

knobs.name: stackGap
knobs.what: world units: distance between the four region stacks

knobs.name: greyMix
knobs.what: how far the grey backdrop marks go from the ground colour toward muted

knobs.name: hscale
knobs.what: world units: height of the value 25 (scale fixed: vmin 0, vmax 25)

knobs.name: terrW
knobs.what: world units: terrain width (40 columns)

knobs.name: zStretch
knobs.what: depth of a cell as a fraction of its width (mesas squarer; cells and values are unchanged)

knobs.name: planeA
knobs.what: opacity of the translucent cut plane

knobs.name: cutIE
knobs.what: column of the Ireland mesa the cut snaps to (columns 2 to 5)

knobs.name: tiltX

knobs.name: tiltY

knobs.name: tiltZ

knobs.name: swingX

knobs.name: cutUS

knobs.name: labLeader

knobs.name: plateA
knobs.what: opacity of the plate behind readouts and pins
